SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I. Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / FOR RECORD / No 3. B. D. 947 / Branch. [手写签名]）
Date April 25 1939.

Subject G.I. Chistiakoff , candidate for the position of Police Watchman
( Russian )
Made by D. S. Pavloff. Forwarded by [手写签名]

Georgy Ilyitch CHISTIAKOFF , 2I , Russian ,
came to notice of the Municipal Police in August
1938 in connection with a case of illegal functioning
of the notorious M.N. Tretiakoff , chairman of the
so-called " Anti-Communis Committee " in Wayside
District.

Brief summary of the case is as follows:-
On August 2 , 1938 two male Russians were
arrested in Wayside District by a Japanese wearing
civilian clothes . When questioned at the Wayside
Police Station , the Japanese stated that he was
acting on information recieved from M.N. Tretiakoff
who alleged that the two Russians were communists.
Being summoned to the Station , Tretiakoff arrived
in company with G.I. Chistiakoff. Questioned as
to what he had to do with the case , the latter
individual stated that he was working for the Japanese
Secret Service. He also asked not to mention his
name in the police report.

In connection with Chistiakoff's statement that
he was working for the Japanese Secret Service it
would be of interest to note that soon after the
incident referred to above , he succeded in securing
a position with the Chinese Army Arsenal in Swatow,
together with two other Russians named I.Innokentiev
and V.Prokofieff , respectively. They served in
Swatow until February 1939 when they were offered
a similar position in Chungking.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别股（S.I. Special Branch）。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 存档 / 编号 3. B. D. 947 / 股别。[手写签名]）
日期：1939年4月25日。

事由：G.I. Chistiakoff，警员职位候选人
（俄籍）
撰写人：D. S. Pavloff。转呈人：[手写签名]

Georgy Ilyitch CHISTIAKOFF，21岁，俄国人，
于1938年8月因涉及臭名昭著的M.N. Tretiakoff非法活动一案而进入工部局警务处的视线，Tretiakoff系所谓“反共委员会”在Wayside区的主席。

案件简要摘要如下：-
1938年8月2日，两名俄国男子在Wayside区被一名身着便服的日本人逮捕。在Wayside巡捕房受审时，该日本人称其行动是基于从M.N. Tretiakoff处获得的情报，Tretiakoff指控这两名俄国人是共产党分子。Tretiakoff被传唤至巡捕房后，与G.I. Chistiakoff一同抵达。当被问及他与本案有何关联时，后者声称他为日本特务机关工作。他还要求不要在警务报告中提及他的姓名。

鉴于Chistiakoff声称其为日本特务机关工作，值得注意的是，在上述事件发生后不久，他便成功在汕头中国军队兵工厂谋得职位，同行的还有另外两名分别名为I.Innokentiev和V.Prokofieff的俄国人。他们在汕头服务至1939年2月，当时他们获邀前往重庆担任类似职务。

to be a Soviet citizen , agreed to proceed to
Chungking , and the other two , including the
applicant , returned to Shanghai.

It would seem from the above , that in trying
to obtain a position with the Shanghai Dockyards
Co. Ltd. , Chistiakoff may be inspired by some
ulterior motive.

综上所述，Chistiakoff在试图获得上海船坞有限公司（Shanghai Dockyards Co. Ltd.）的职位时，可能受到某种隐秘动机的驱使。
